groups.name: Latin S–XL
groups.credit: Latin Character Sets by Christoph Koeberlin

sets.name: Latin S
sets.summary: A global Latin minimum: Europe plus about 100 more languages, including the Pan-Nigerian alphabet.

sets.name: Latin M
sets.summary: Latin S plus Vietnamese and DIN 91379.

sets.name: Latin L
sets.summary: Latin M plus Pan-African Latin and indigenous languages of the Americas.

sets.name: Latin XL
sets.summary: Latin L plus IPA and Americanist phonetic notation.

groups.name: Adobe Latin
groups.credit: Adobe Latin Character Sets by Adobe

sets.name: Adobe Latin 1
sets.summary: Western European languages.

sets.name: Adobe Latin 2
sets.summary: Adobe Latin 1 plus common symbols; the minimum for Std fonts.

sets.name: Adobe Latin 3
sets.summary: Adds Central European languages; the minimum for Pro fonts.

sets.name: Adobe Latin 4
sets.summary: Adds Vietnamese and many more European, African and Pacific languages.

sets.name: Adobe Latin 5
sets.summary: Adds more African and Berber languages, Navajo and others.

sets.name: GF Latin Kernel
sets.summary: Basic Latin letters, figures and punctuation.

sets.name: GF Latin Core
sets.summary: Latin languages of Europe and the Americas with more than 5 million speakers.

sets.name: GF Latin Plus
sets.summary: Latin Core and Vietnamese plus currencies, math and fractions.

sets.name: GF Latin African
sets.summary: Latin Core plus African languages.

sets.name: GF Cyrillic Core
sets.summary: Cyrillic languages with more than 3 million speakers.

sets.name: GF Cyrillic Plus
sets.summary: Adds Cyrillic languages with 240,000 to 3 million speakers.

sets.name: GF Cyrillic Pro
sets.summary: Adds non-Slavic Cyrillic languages.

sets.name: GF Greek Core
sets.summary: Monotonic Modern Greek.

sets.name: GF Greek Plus
sets.summary: Adds polytonic Greek.

sets.name: GF Greek Pro
sets.summary: Adds extended polytonic Greek for scholarly editions.
